item.title: Quick Company Research Tips 🕒 • Visit the company's website; focus on 'About Us' and 'News'. • Check LinkedIn for recent posts and employee insights. • Search for recent news articles on the company. • Review Glassdoor for employee reviews and ratings. • Use: “I noticed your recent expansion in X, which aligns with my skills in Y.” How can you use this info to tailor your interview responses effectively? #jobsearch #interviewprep #ScalePilot #SocialPilot #AIAutomations
